name: Sunday Chili
ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 yellow onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 cans kidney beans, drained
1 can crushed tomatoes
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp cumin
1 cup shredded cheddar
steps:
Brown the beef with the onion, 8 min.
Add garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 min.
Add beans and tomatoes; simmer 40 min.
Serve topped with cheddar.
